question: 统计最近30天各区域GMV，按GMV从高到低排序
golden_sql: SELECT c.region, ROUND(SUM(o.order_amount), 2) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.created_at >= datetime('now', '-30 day') AND o.order_status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY gmv DESC

question: 比较最近30天不同获客渠道的客单价
golden_sql: SELECT c.acquisition_channel, ROUND(SUM(o.order_amount) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.created_at >= datetime('now', '-30 day') AND o.order_status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.acquisition_channel ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC

question: 统计最近30天各商品品类销售额Top10
golden_sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(oi.paid_amount), 2) AS sales_amount FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.created_at >= datetime('now', '-30 day') AND o.order_status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY sales_amount DESC LIMIT 10

question: 计算最近30天整体退款率
golden_sql: WITH gmv AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(order_amount), 0) AS value FROM orders WHERE created_at >= datetime('now', '-30 day') AND order_status <> 'cancelled'), refund AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(refund_amount), 0) AS value FROM refunds WHERE refunded_at >= datetime('now', '-30 day')) SELECT CASE WHEN gmv.value = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(refund.value * 1.0 / gmv.value, 6) END AS refund_rate FROM gmv CROSS JOIN refund

question: 找出最近30天退款金额最高的5个区域
golden_sql: SELECT c.region, ROUND(SUM(r.refund_amount), 2) AS refund_amount FROM refunds r JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE r.refunded_at >= datetime('now', '-30 day') GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY refund_amount DESC LIMIT 5
